hidden_note: The hidden flag follows the official PSN list (28 hidden): story missions, partner finals and secretive trophies stay hidden on PlayStation until earned.
missable_rule: Missable means the official description itself implies a one-chance condition: undetected, back-to-back, a single use of something, a story choice, or a second attempt that counts. Story chapter and mission trophies are never flagged missable: they unlock by playing the campaign.

roadmap.blurb: Play the campaign from Gone Fishing to the final mission. Nothing here can be missed.

sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official data, as listed by Exophase (www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/). PSN target counts (0/N) are from PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). Guides are this guide's own words. Where a guide goes beyond the official description, it says so: exact locations not yet confirmed in public guides are marked as unconfirmed.
